Whole miniature projects — roles, templates, inventories, dictionaries and the
`build.yml`/`sheet.yml` that read them — existing so the recipe tests have
something the size of a real build to run against, and so
`tests/goldens/extraction.json` pins which parser every kind of file in one
resolves to.

They are a CORPUS, not a showcase: each was kept for the cases it covers, not
for what it demonstrates. The generated `input.json` / `sheet.html` are
gitignored and regenerated by

    cd tests/fixtures/projects/<name>
    bun run ../../../../src/cli.ts import --spec review-sheet/build.yml -o input.json

| project | covers |
| --- | --- |
| `ansible-basic` | the widest parser set — toml and sysctl appear nowhere else |
| `ansible-keycloak` | dictionaries + overlays, materialize, `split:`, `keyMap`, argument_specs |
| `ansible-httpd` | per-language provenance: `en` from argument_specs, `ja` from the dictionary |
| `cdk-snapshot` | the `snapshot` recipe |
